scope: Research rules only. National transitional, posthumous, rehabilitation, scientific/critical-edition, moral-rights and remuneration exceptions require separate review. No worldwide clearance is asserted.

eu-term.territory: EU member states; ordinary rule, not a country-by-country clearance
eu-term.basis: Directive 2006/116/EC Articles 1 and 8: ordinarily author life plus 70 years, counted from the next January. Articles 4, 5 and 10 require separate publication/critical-edition/transitional consideration.

ukraine-term.basis: Law 2811-IX Article 31: ordinarily life plus 70; joint, anonymous, posthumously rehabilitated authors and first publication require separate review.

mexico-comparison.basis: Article 29 includes life plus 100, with separate posthumous/disclosure provisions. Arithmetic alone does not establish Mexican or worldwide rights.

us-publication.territory: United States; first-publication date must be evidenced
us-publication.basis: Project Gutenberg Rule 1 describes pre-1931 qualifying publication expiry in 2026. No publication date is inferred from an author's death or an electronic release date.

berne-translations.basis: Translations/adaptations have independent protection; duration and exceptions vary by national law.
